page.title: Page setup
page.impositionInfoNone: Prints pages in reading order — best for plain printing and reading.
page.impositionInfoBooklet: Imposes the whole book onto front/back sheets, padded to a multiple of 4; fold at the spine after printing.
page.impositionInfoThread: Each signature holds sheets × 4 reading pages, stacked and thread-sewn; the last signature is padded with blanks.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Preferences are stored locally and survive app restarts.
